protocol: Frozen 2026-02-01 models and history; February-May reused development cohort
selection: All price/type/size/month slices; all communities archived, >=100 homes for narrative comparisons
size_definition: Midpoint of reported area range; lower-inclusive 1000/2000 sq-ft cut points
limitations: Outcome-defined price slices are retrospective only.
Community extremes are selected after inspection and are not generalization estimates.
Community/size comparisons are unadjusted for type, price and other correlated attributes.
No models, routes or forecasts were changed based on this diagnostic.
